subject: Production Algorithm32-hi CPU Reference, 40/20/68/48 numerical controls

mismatches.disposition: Algorithm32-hi computes its native 15 equal-width channels. For the unchanged paper RMSE coordinates, each value is held constant over its declared bin; no 40-channel transport realization is substituted.

The production sky-only Algorithm32-hi benchmark calculation has no ground-reflection contribution, while the matched libRadtran setup uses Lambertian grass spectral albedo. Treat the resulting comparison as scope-limited rather than input-identical.
Algorithm32-hi uses its canonical wavelength law and coefficient scale; the libRadtran deck uses the retained Penndorf table. Preserve this as a model-family difference.

Algorithm32-hi uses its production incident-radiance cache and documented truncated scattering calculation; libRadtran DISORT is the fuller numerical reference. Do not interpret aggregate-score proximity as component or pointwise equality.

Algorithm32-hi uses 68 source-oriented equal-weight Fibonacci incident directions; the retained libRadtran DISORT calculation resolves its angular field with 16 streams. Preserve this numerical-method difference.

Algorithm32-hi uses analytic exponential density profiles, 48 cache altitude representatives, 40 view-path intervals, and 20 source-transmittance intervals; libRadtran uses its retained layered atmosphere and solver controls.
Algorithm32-hi uses exact ray intersections with its spherical atmosphere; the retained libRadtran setup is pseudospherical. Treat the distinction as a declared model mismatch.

Algorithm32-hi evaluates at two meters above its spherical ground boundary; the retained libRadtran deck uses zero-kilometer output altitude. Report the two-meter choice and do not conceal the difference.

Algorithm32-hi uses an ideal unresolved distant directional Sun and reports atmosphere path radiance without a resolved solar disc; preserve this boundary when comparing with the retained solver output and measurements.
